basis: Fresh DC003 normal-final computed records plus read-only source inspection, not historical Task012 results.
paintProof: BrandPattern is an aria-hidden positioned span, before the relative text content in the same parent. Recorded related spans have opacity1.
Only normal alpha gradients are used by these related spans. CSS masks can only reduce their alpha. No source filter/mix-blend or recoloring is applied.
Light section/conic figure text has only the recorded decorative related layer; its transparent stop gives alpha0 and its maximum-alpha stop bounds all samples.
The Home dark figure has two 9%-alpha blue grid layers under the12%-alpha cyan radial layer. Both line crossings and mask attenuation are covered by independent alpha ranges0..0.09,0..0.09,0..0.12.
Source layer/paint assumptions are valid only while all listed file SHA match both input manifest and current source. Any change requires renewed source review.
